workflows.name: E-Commerce Order Processing & Saga Compensation
workflows.description: Mission-critical distributed transaction executing Payment Capture, Warehouse Inventory Reservation, and Carrier Dispatch with automatic backward Saga rollback upon downstream failure.

data.label: Receive Order Event
data.description: Triggers on incoming customer order event with cart payload

data.label: Authorize & Capture Payment
data.description: Charges customer payment method via Stripe/Adyen API

compensation.name: Refund Payment Transaction
compensation.simulatedAction: Refund $249.99 to customer credit card via payment gateway

data.label: Reserve Warehouse Inventory
data.description: Locks physical SKU units in inventory management system

compensation.name: Release Reserved Inventory
compensation.simulatedAction: Released 1 unit of SKU-QUANTUM-X back to active inventory pool

data.label: Evaluate Inventory Status
data.description: Checks if warehouse response confirmed physical stock availability

data.label: Create Carrier Shipment & Waybill
data.description: Dispatches parcel via FedEx/DHL logistics API

compensation.name: Void Carrier Shipping Label
compensation.simulatedAction: Voided carrier shipping label and cancelled pickup dispatch

data.label: Generate Order Invoice & Telemetry
data.description: Calculates tax, discounts and formats executive summary in VM sandbox

data.label: Log Out-of-Stock Alert
data.description: Publishes notification when inventory check fails
data.logMessage: Order entered backorder state: warehouse allocation unsuccessful

data.label: Order Processing Complete
data.description: Workflow execution succeeded and customer transaction closed
